messages:
priya: quick quarterly pass on recurring incidents across Jan–Mar. I pulled top recurring causes and sketched fixes in the sheet: https://redwood.company/sheets/recurring-q2. TL;DR: (1) KV cache evictions leading to costy regen, (2) autoscaler misconfig during ramps, (3) image-pull flaps in eu-west, (4) GPU OOMs for long-context requests, (5) config drift on rollout flags. Asking: owners + short-term mitigations (2 weeks) + tracked ticket numbers.

marta: thanks. can we get a short owner for each? I can take the image-pull flaps and work with registry team.

kevin: happy to own the KV cache item. immediate plan: increase small-shard eviction thresholds and enable conservative prefetch. low-risk change.

jordan: i'll own autoscaler config. i want to run a simple replay test against canary before changing prod. estimate 5 days.

priya: thanks. can we capture action items succinctly here so product-ops can follow? propose format: AI-ID | short desc | owner | due-date | jira.

marta: AI-2026 | fix image-pull retry backoff + fallback registry | marta | 2026-04-07 | RED-5981

kevin: AI-2027 | reduce KV eviction pressure, add prefix caching | kevin | 2026-04-10 | RED-6012

jordan: AI-2028 | autoscaler threshold tuning + replay test | jordan | 2026-04-09 | RED-6020

priya: GPU OOMs — who can triage? looks like long-context chat workloads spike memory. suggested mitigations: short-term: cap max input length per plan, route heavy requests to dedicated pools; medium: quantize model variant for long-context and enable spilling.

kevin: I can prototype a quantized variant but need infra approval for dedicated pool routing. will spin a draft design doc.

marta: can we add a monitoring rule for sudden per-model memory growth? sample query: ```sum_over_time(gpu_memory_used_bytes{model=~".*long.*"}[10m]) > 0.8 * gpu_capacity_bytes``` let me know if that looks noisy.

jordan: looks good. add an alert with a 3-minute window and a slack-runbook link.

postmortem-bot: Automated note: created tracking tickets RED-5981, RED-6012, RED-6020. Will post weekly progress summary on Fridays.

priya: two other asks: 1) can we surface a 90-day recurring incident heatmap in the dashboard? 2) schedule a 30-min sync in two weeks to check progress.

kevin: 1) i'll add a dashboard tile (heatmap by root-cause) — target 2026-04-12.

marta: 2) +1 on the sync. i'll block time for April 13 09:30 PT.

jordan: note that a couple of postmortems had action items without owners — i've flagged them in RED-6005 and assigned tentatively to oncall rotation. We should avoid that. proposal: postmortem workflow must include explicit owner and due date before closing.

priya: agreed. adding that as policy: new requirement — PM/author must assign remediation owner + due date on the postmortem before marking resolved. I'll update the template.

marta: small note: for the image-pull work i'll need a cert rotation window with registry team. calling out now so timelines stay realistic.

kevin: got it. i'll coordinate.

priya: final: i'll compile these AIs into the ops spreadsheet and ping product-ops. postmortem-bot, please remind assignees 3 days before due date. :thumbsup:

postmortem-bot: Reminder rule set. Will DM owners 3 days prior and post weekly status in #incidents every Friday.

jordan: cheers. thanks everyone. reconvene Apr 13 to verify mitigations and close AIs. :calendar:
